title: Nervous System as a System
definition: The nervous system is the body's rapid information-processing and response system.
description: It detects changes, interprets them, and coordinates a suitable response.
key_points: Need / role|Information processing|Input → Processing → Output|Receptor → Nervous system → Effector
memory_badge: Nervous system = rapid communication and response
think_prompt: How does the body detect change and coordinate a response?
quick_check: What are the three broad stages of a nervous system as a system?

title: Need and role of the nervous system
definition: The nervous system helps the body detect changes and coordinate suitable responses.
description: Different parts of the body must communicate quickly to prevent harm and maintain control.
think_prompt: You touch something hot. Why must parts of the body communicate quickly?
quick_check: Why do organisms need a nervous system?
answer: To detect internal and external changes and respond appropriately and rapidly.

title: Nervous system as an information-processing system
definition: The nervous system receives information, processes it, and produces a response.
description: This system is responsible for interpreting signals and sending instructions to the appropriate effectors.
think_prompt: What must happen before a body can respond appropriately to a stimulus?
quick_check: What are the three jobs of the nervous system?
answer: Receiving information, processing it, and producing an appropriate response.

title: Input → Processing → Output
definition: A nervous response can be represented as Input → Processing → Output.
description: Input is information from the surroundings, processing is coordination, and output is the action taken.
think_prompt: If light reaches the eye, which part represents input and which part represents output?

title: Overall flow: receptor → nervous system → effector
definition: A receptor detects a stimulus, the nervous system coordinates the information, and an effector produces the response.
description: Sensory organs detect the signal, the nervous system processes it, and muscles or glands carry out the response.
think_prompt: Which part detects the stimulus and which part finally carries out the response?
